about_the_game:
Explore deep caves filled with massive crystals thanks to the KR Quartz Cave Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has created an MV/MZ-sized tileset inspired by the incredible Naica Mine, with large stone stalactites and translucent white crystals piercing up through the floor. Send your heroes into a dungeon formed by water and heat and untouched by humans to find large gems that can be used in magical crafting, and add more gorgeous crystals to monster-filled dungeons!

A1, A2, A4, and 3 B sheets include all the stone and quartz tiles you could want to build maze-like mines and massive crystal-filled caverns. Create a seemingly normal cave entrance with dirt floors and brown stone walls, but hint at something special further in with small bunches of crystals poking out of the floor. As your heroes explore deeper, have the floor shift from packed dirt to sandy floors where sand flows like a waterfall from the ceiling and reveal spots of crystals in the walls. Lead them down unassuming tunnels by embedding trails of glowing crystals in the floor, and stud the larger caves with crystal bunches that are three times taller than your heroes. Let nature form pathways by having angled stone walls and piles of rocks force your heroes in specific directions, or make mazes of crystals where your heroes need to walk behind and between the crystal pillars to find their way out of the cave. Pick up the KR Quartz Cave Tileset and add a new type of cave for your heroes to conquer!


The Quartz Cave Tileset Includes:


Ground tiles:

Animated glowing crystal ground cover (RPG Maker only), dirt, rocky ground, wavy dirt, sandfalls, crystal edges and paths, holes, small crystals and more!


Walls/roofs:

Walls to match floor tiles, with lots of textures to choose from. Also includes punched-out wall sections with dark and lit holes.


Also includes:

Wall tiles with inward slope
Large variety of plain (small) crystals
Huge quartz crystals in a wide variety of patterns
Rocks and stalactites in lots of choices
and more!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
